#define RUNTIME_CHECK(cond, msg) \
    do { \
        if (!(cond)) { \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[FAIL] %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, (msg)); \
            return 1; \
        } \
    } while(0)

#define P1PHOT_CHECK_MSG(cs, cond, faultname, ...)                         \
    do {                                                                   \
        if ((cs).fault_reported && (faultname) != nullptr) {               \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        } else if (faultname != nullptr &&                                 \
                   p1phot::FaultRegistry::instance().injected(faultname)) { \
            (cs).note_injected(faultname);                                 \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        } else if (!(cond)) {                                              \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "CHECK failed %s:%d: %s — ",              \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond);                       \
            std::fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                             \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                    \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        }                                                                  \
    } while (0)

#define COS_CANCEL_CHECKPOINT(what)                                     \
        do {                                                                \
            if (inst->host && inst->host->cancel &&                          \
                inst->host->cancel->is_cancelled &&                          \
                inst->host->cancel->is_cancelled(                            \
                    inst->host->cancel->user_data)) {                        \
                if (lease_active) {                                          \
                    if (ex->release) ex->release(ex->user_data, leased);     \
                    if (omp_prev > 0) COS_OMP_SET(omp_prev);                 \
                }                                                            \
                return efill(err, ACS_ERR_CANCELLED,                         \
                             ACS_ERR_DOMAIN_CANCELLED,                       \
                             "cancelled " what, ACS_DIAG_ECODE_NONE);        \
            }                                                                \
        } while (0)

P1COS_CHECK_EQ
body:
#define P1COS_CHECK_EQ(cs, got, want)                                      \
    do {                                                                   \
        const auto g_ = (got), w_ = (want);                                \
        if (!(g_ == w_)) {                                                 \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "CHECK failed %s:%d: got=%lld want=%lld (%s)\n", \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__,                             \
                         static_cast<long long>(g_),                     \
                         static_cast<long long>(w_), #got);              \
            ++(cs).failures;                                             \
        }                                                                  \
    } while (0)
